design: MIMIC-IV patient-level stratified 70/30; fixed MIMIC-III historical cross-version external validation
shadow_threshold: one-sided binomial p<0.05 / eligible feature count against strongest shadow
rfe_scoring: five-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC within IV training only
preprocessing: train-fold median imputation, train-fold empirical quantile normalisation; final refit on IV training only
bootstrap: 1000 stratified patient resamples, fixed model, percentile 95% intervals
